notes.title: Kickstarter Coming Soon! + New Trailer!
notes.content: [h3]🔎Kickstarter Coming Soon![/h3][p]I'm looking at launching a Kickstarter soon, potentially in October! This is to fund the OST that Fatbard (Bubsy 4D, Crashlands 2, Die in the Dungeon) is putting together, and it's going to be awesome![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lkmkgames/mansion-of-a-million-monsters"]Follow Mansions of a Million Monsters! on Kickstarter by clicking here![/url][/p][p][/p][h3]🔎Updated Trailer![/h3][p]I've been hard at work this summer adding LOTS of new art, content, and QOL features to Mansion of a Million Monsters!, and created a new trailer to showcase it! Check it out on the store page![/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3627210/008308e5ae5fda4c6d323bc764e0e7dde86c90e1/ss_008308e5ae5fda4c6d323bc764e0e7dde86c90e1.1920x1080.jpg?t=1758143502"][/img][/p][p]I couldn't fit everything into the new trailer, but if you want to see development previews, you can follow along on BlueSky or TikTok using the links below![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lkmkgames/mansion-of-a-million-monsters" style="button"]Follow Mansions of a Million Monsters! on Kickstarter by clicking here![/url][/p]
